newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon to start Global Commmand work.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon to start Global Commmand work.

text.p: Raytheon Co's Raytheon E-Systems said it would begin work this week on a Department of Defense contract to support the new Global Command and Control System.
Raytheon E-Systems said the Defense Information Systems Agency had informed the company that all protests against the award of the contract to Rayteon had been withdrawn.
The contract is for one year, with four one-year options, and is expected to generate as much as $250 million in revenue.

The Global Command and Control System is a new worldwide command and control communications system that replaces the Worldwide Military Command and Control System that has been in operation for the past two decades.
